cohort: 3,723 deliveries at a safety-net institution in Atlanta, Georgia, during 2016-2018
finding: The study found that HDP was significantly associated with an increased risk of SMM, with cesarean delivery playing a role in mediating this association.
mod_finding: Approximately 24.9% of the excess relative risk of SMM associated with HDP was due to an interaction between HDP and cesarean delivery, while 9.6% was due to mediation by cesarean delivery, and 10.3% was due to both mediation and interaction.
